title: Collectable coins
prompt:
Write one server Script. It gives every player (also ones already in the game) a "leaderstats" Folder with an
IntValue "Coins" starting at 0. It creates a Folder named "Coins" in `script.Parent` with 5 anchored Parts named
"Coin" (CanCollide false) at positions (400 + 10 * i, 50, 400) for i = 1..5. When a player's character touches a
coin, that player gets exactly +1 Coins and the coin is destroyed; a coin can never be counted twice, even when
several body parts touch it at once.
